title: ExtractionProfile
description: How to read one file. Files live in apps/api/model-profiles/extract/<name>.yaml and are selected by EXTRACTION_PROFILE. A profile is validated at startup: a broken one stops the process, exactly like a broken scenario.

name.description: Must equal the file stem, so a rename cannot silently change behaviour.

family.description: Recognizer family. none reads digital documents only and refuses scans with a reason.

model.description: Engine-specific model selector. Empty means the family default.

lang.description: Document language as an ISO 639-1 code. The recognizer maps it to its own script route.

dpi.description: Rasterization resolution for the recognition path. Digital documents never render.

min_text_chars.description: Below this many characters of native text the document is treated as a scan.

quality.description: Gate applied to the raster before recognition. null disables one check.

min_edge_energy.description: Blur proxy: variance of an edge filter. Unset until the golden set calibrates it.

acceptance.description: What makes the result indexable. One unreadable page refuses the document.
